0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, first in the Atlantic, second in the East) host the Pistons (2-0, first in the Central and first in the East), with Philadelphia unbeaten at home at 2-0 and riding a three-game win streak. Philadelphia is without Joel Embiid (heel), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the 76ers lost all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 116-93 defeat in Philadelphia in their most recent game against Detroit.
